name: Daniel
label: Music-first subscriber resenting podcast push
who: I'm a Spotify Premium subscriber who mainly wants music and treats podcasts as a side thing. I listen to a few shows, sometimes in other apps like Overcast or Pocket Casts, and I get annoyed when the podcast push takes over my home screen.
value_for_money: Premium is seen mainly as paying for ad-free music, and these users say podcast ads still play for Premium subscribers, which feels like paying for nothing. One user says podcasts were added at the same price, which they see as fine, and another says Premium is more expensive than the alternative but still finds the ad load tolerable. Price itself is not a central complaint.
loyalty: They stay for the convenience of having some podcasts and music in one app, easy device integration, and fewer podcast ads than on YouTube. They would leave for a music-focused app or a service without the podcast push; one user left for Apple Music and another said they might switch to YouTube Premium.
pain_points: Podcasts pushed onto home screen and library
Podcast ads still play for Premium users
Hard to hide or filter out podcasts
likes: One app for music and some podcasts
Fewer ads than YouTube on podcasts
reasons_to_stay: They keep Spotify for music and for the convenience of having some podcasts in the same app, and one user says they are pretty happy with the ad experience. Device integration is a plus for them, and they say the ads they hear on Spotify are less than on YouTube. Their complaints focus on the podcast push and the interface rather than the service as a whole.
tone: Blunt, sarcastic, and fed up, with frequent swearing and comparisons to other apps.
